name: TerminusDB

evidence.nosql: C02: versioned document and knowledge-graph database with schema-checked JSON and graph queries

line: Versioned document graph database; vector search is documented in v12.1 RC.

free.text: Apache-2.0; no vendor quota or idle rule; you host and retain the data

cells.metered: Free self-hosted; managed Cloud has no public price
cells.regions: Self-host anywhere; Cloud region list unpublished

sql.math: The Apache-2.0 software costs $0 (a free open-source license). Host, disk, backups, transfer and tax are not priced here.
The software stays $0 while idle. Server, kept storage, backup and transfer costs depend on your host.

files.math: TerminusDB is a graph and document database, not a file storage service.

jobs.math: TerminusDB does not host background job workers
